query:
SELECT 
  state_code, state_name, status, rating,
  candidate1_name, candidate1_party,
  candidate2_name, candidate2_party,
  incumbent, incumbent_party, incumbent_retiring,
  primary_date, general_date,
  called_winner, called_party,
  pct_reporting, notes
FROM senate_races
ORDER BY primary_date, state_code;

Incumbent Lindsey Graham (R) seeking re-election. Primary June 9, 2026.

Tommy Tuberville (R) is not seeking re-election; running for governor instead. D runoff June 16: Everett Wess vs. Dakarai Larriett. R runoff June 16: Barry Moore vs. Jared Hudson. Neither party nominee confirmed until June 16.

Adam Schiff (D) is the incumbent seeking his first full term after being appointed in December 2024. California uses a top-two jungle primary — the top two finishers regardless of party advance to November. Schiff is expected to advance easily. Rated Solid D.
Open seat — Joni Ernst (R) not running for re-election. D primary June 2: Josh Turek vs Zach Wahls. R primary June 2: Jim Carlin vs Ashley Hinson. Cook/IE/Sabato: Likely Republican.

rows.notes: Open seat — Markwayne Mullin resigned. R primary Jun 16: Kevin Hern (frontrunner), Sean Buckner, Gary England, Nick Hankins, Brian Ragain, Tammy Swearengin, Wayne Washington. D primary Jun 16: R.O. Joe Cassity, Troy Green, Rebekah LaVann, Jim Priest, N'Kiyla Thomas, Ervin Yen. Rating: Solid Republican.

BREAKING (Apr 30, 2026): Gov. Janet Mills suspended her Senate campaign Thursday morning, citing lack of financial resources. Mills had been trailing progressive challenger Graham Platner — a military veteran and oyster farmer — in both polls and fundraising. Mills was the preferred candidate of Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer and national Democrats. Platner is now the presumptive Democratic nominee heading into the June 9 Democratic primary. General election: Platner vs. Sen. Susan Collins (R), a 5-term incumbent. Collins is now in a stronger position with Mills out of the race. Rating moved from Toss-up to Lean R. Source: Politico, NBC News, CBS News, Axios (Apr 30, 2026).
Primary held March 10, 2026. Incumbent Cindy Hyde-Smith (R) defeated primary challengers. Scott Colom (D) won Democratic primary.
Open seat (Durbin retiring). Juliana Stratton (D, Lt. Gov) vs Don Tracy (R). Inside Elections: Solid Democratic. Illinois is reliably Democratic.
Shoffner won D primary Mar 3 (def. Ethan Dunbar). Cotton won R primary Mar 3 (81.6%). Rated Solid R.
Open seat (Tillis retiring). Roy Cooper (D) won D primary Mar 3. Michael Whatley (R) won R primary Mar 3 (64.6%). Inside Elections: Toss-up (Mar 2026). Cook: Toss-up.

John Cornyn (Republican) is the incumbent seeking re-election as Ken Paxton is seeking to un-seat the longtime Senator. Paxton, the former Texas Attorney General and Trump-endorsed candidate, won the May 26, 2026 Republican primary runoff. He faces Democrat James Talarico in the November 3, 2026 general election.

Incumbent Pete Ricketts (R) running for re-election. D primary May 12: Cindy Burbank, William Forbes. Dan Osborn (I) also running in general. R primary May 12: Ricketts + challengers. Cook/IE/Sabato: Likely R.
Incumbent Shelley Moore Capito (R) seeking re-election. Primary May 12, 2026.

Both parties in runoff June 27. GOP: Julia Letlow (45%) vs. John Fleming (28%) — incumbent Cassidy eliminated. Dem: Jamie Davis (47%) vs. Gary Crockett. GOP runoff winner heavily favored in November. Neither party nominee confirmed until June 27.
R primary runoff June 16: Mike Collins (incumbent Rep.) vs. Derek Dooley (former UT football coach). Winner faces incumbent Sen. Jon Ossoff (D) in November. Rated Lean D.
Incumbent Jim Risch (R) seeking re-election. Primary May 19, 2026.

Open seat — Mitch McConnell (R) retiring after 40 years. Andy Barr (R, Trump-endorsed) defeated Daniel Cameron and others. Charles Booker (D) defeated Amy McGrath. Kentucky is R+26; rated Solid R by all outlets.

Incumbent Jeff Merkley (D) seeking his 3rd term. Primary May 19, 2026. Republican primary features 7 candidates including Jo Rae Perkins (2020 and 2022 GOP nominee) and David Brock Smith (state rep). Merkley won 2020 with 56.9%. Rated Solid D by all outlets.
Incumbent Ed Markey (D) seeking re-election. Primary September 1, 2026.
Incumbent Chris Coons (D) seeking re-election. Primary September 15, 2026.
Open seat — Jeanne Shaheen (D) not running for re-election. D primary Sep 8: Chris Pappas, Karishma Manzur. R primary Sep 8: Scott Brown, John Sununu, others. Cook/Sabato: Lean D. IE: Tilt D.
Incumbent Jack Reed (D) seeking re-election. Primary September 8, 2026.
